caseName: Citizens Concerned for Separation of Church & State v. City & County of Denver
caseNameFull: Citizens Concerned for Separation of Church and State v. City and County of Denver

opinions.text:
Application to vacate the order of the United States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit, entered December 3, 1980, presented to Justice White, and by him referred to the Court, denied.

Justice Brennan, Justice White, and Justice Stevens dissent.
